Nickel (ore, Ni content)

All three rows from the same USGS Minerals Yearbook 2022, Russia chapter. No owner is printed for the other three rows. Capacity is stated as capacity, not production.

What is missing

An export/trade-flow dataset (e.g., customs declarations or a trade-statistics report) would settle it.

For context that the mined material feeds a downstream chokepoint: rare-earth magnet sintering is a Sourced analyst-tracked bottleneck (binding score 10/12, judged on 2026-09-15, analyst judgement, not a sourced fact), concentrated in one jurisdiction downstream of the mine — and Russia's 2025 mine production is 2,600 t (estimated), 0.67% of world total, per USGS Mineral Commodity Summaries 2026.
